description: This file contains shell functions for testing a library script, specifically for writing, executing, and verifying sub-tests within a shell testing framework.

methods.name: write_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Creates a test subdirectory, writes a test script into it including sourcing the test-lib.sh, and prepares it for execution.

methods.name: _run_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Executes the specified test script, setting up environment variables, handling skip options, and checking exit codes.

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Creates and runs a passing sub-test by invoking the creation and execution functions.

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Creates and runs a failing sub-test similarly to the above but expects an error.

methods.name: run_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Runs a test expected to succeed.

methods.name: run_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Runs a test expected to fail.

methods.name: _check_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Compares the actual output of a test with the expected output.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Checks that the test output matches the expected output and that there is no error output.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Checks that the test output and error output both match expectations.
